caption: The drawing displays a single white bonnet, oriented with the opening facing left, rendered in grayscale on a neutral, light beige background. The bonnet is composed of different fabric textures and patterns, including gathered and ruched sections along the edge, netting with tiny dot embellishments, and narrow bands of intricate lacework. The surface of the bonnet shows detailed shading that accentuates the folds and layers of the fabric, with particular attention to the translucency of the lace and netted areas. The lower edge of the bonnet is finished with a ruffled, pleated band. There is a signature "R. Mauersk" located towards the lower right segment of the image, near the edge of the bonnet. No other objects are present in the composition.
title: Child's Lace Cap
